theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ → (∀ g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, g (t⁻¹ • (z - x)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n]))) → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < ENNReal.ofReal θ * unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall x t)
